notes.title: Patch with bug fixes and user experience improvements
notes.notes:
1. Added Lens Flares

2. Fixed some dialogue sounds

3. Fixed some music playback errors

4. Added more in-game hints that are organically integrated into the gameplay, now you:

4.1 Be sure to find the scanner in the Prologue

4.2 Don't miss the garbage chute in Part 1

5. Fixed some shortcomings in the plot forks in Part 1

6. NEW PART 1 TRAILER CHECK IT OUT

7. Fixed the translation of the notes

8. Slightly fixed the behavior of the camera when changing poses, now it is more difficult to break it (why are you trying to break it? just play)

9. Added an outline to the subtitles

10. Fixed some physical contours of objects

11. Fixed light leakage in the owner's apartment in Part 1

12. Fixed a bug due to which some cutscenes could not be skipped

notes.title: Massive update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

This is 0-Game Studios and we are proud to present the full demo version. Now it includes a fully finished Part 1, this part of the game takes place inside an apartment building in the middle of Intown, you are a resident of this house - Henry, who one day discovers that you can no longer leave the house, and every day a mysterious mold takes over more areas of the house.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843699/514535f3e94fa8f46b705a9c655f51cc5ac26439.png"]

Fight back against this mold! Each of the 4 neighbors will offer an option to fight the mold, choose whose approach suits you best and be prepared to face the consequences. The game has 6 endings, one for each neighbor, one for your cat Abis and one is the worst.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843699/792200b16b6976925d513be0a7dc78369cae153f.png"]

Replay the game, opening new endings through the choice of levels in the menu.

See you in 2026, during the end of the world, do not miss it by adding the game to your wishlist!

notes.title: Release of demo version
notes.notes: 0-Game Studios has released a demo version of the horror almanac Intown Nightmares! Maria accepts a job in the woods where she is to collect never-before-seen mushrooms, but strange dreams, moving objects and time distortion begin to haunt Maria. This demo is just the beginning of a larger story unfolding in the dystopian city of Intown. Don't miss the opportunity to plunge into the world of nightmares come true!
